summary: Automations task inbox: review fixes from #1413 — retry notification checks on transient errors, validate a task form's submission and its final deadline before the form acts, keep permission grants and tasks usable when role or subject lookups fail, count quorum progress by agreeing votes, page the inbox stably across escalations (human_task_escalations.due_before), read a task and its decisions in one snapshot, keep sidebar folders holding ForEveryone items, safer decision form (danger confirmation, optional booleans, exact numbers, JSON fallback), and pt-BR/zh translations.
